title: SafeGen: Embedding Ethical Safeguards in Text-to-Image Generation
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is the development and evaluation of 'SafeGen,' a framework dedicated to embedding ethical safeguards into generative AI. It evaluates the system based on five ethical pillars (Fairness, Harm Prevention, Transparency, etc.) and includes a specific 'Ethical Validation' section that tests the model's ability to identify and reject harmful or biased prompts.
